EC1: - Birthweight ≥ 1500 g [OR] and/or gestation age ≥ 32 weeks
EC2: - Lack of informed consent of the parents
EC3: - Congenital heart defect, other than PDA [OR] and/or patent foramen ovale (PFO)
EC4: - The presence of a clinically apparent hemorrhagic syndrome
EC5: - Any intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) in the first 48 hours [OR] or IVH grade 3-4
EC7: - A serum creatinine concentration of > 110 μmol/L
